newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris says Q4 margins rose.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris says Q4 margins rose.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc said Monday its earnings in the fourth quarter ended February 1 rose to record levels thanks in part to higher sales and margins.
The company reported net income of $6.8 million, or $0.62 a share, compared with $4.2 million, or $0.42 a share, one year ago. There were 13 weeks in the latest period, down from 14 weeks last year.
Sales rose to $68.6 million from $59.3 million last year, the company said.
Paul Harris said it expects to add at least 30 locations in 1997.
Paul Harris sells its Paul Harris Design private label apparel in 224 locations.
Its shares were off 1-3/8 Monday at 16-5/8.
